Earlier gameplay summary (agent-written, uncertain claims remain uncertain):
Goal/state: Exploring MOSS GROTTO, trying to climb from pool via bridge and upper platforms to a higher right ledge with green bud. No explicit quest, victory condition, terminal screen, or bud interaction observed. Health remains TWO white masks (three dark), unchanged throughout this segment. Earlier contact near right-bank spiny creature cost third mask. Latest observed frame: at water level RIGHT of leafy platform, lower stone above-right. Last action Right 0.4s (z released) completed; no subsequent screenshot, so resulting position unknown. Immediate goal remains regain footholds and upward route.
Controls/evidence: Left/Right move; z jumps; x attacks (earlier). c has been called dash, but no clearly demonstrated advantage. Latest Left+c 0.4s from high above-right of leafy moved back above leafy's left edge; not proof of dash mechanics. Up used as release of horizontal/z; Up+z used for nominal vertical jumps. No independent Up interaction established. Up/Down do NOT reliably halt horizontal travel. Fresh jumps after releasing z have worked. Sustained directional+z beside platform sides has repeatedly produced high ascents with white trails, sometimes after feet were below platform top; mechanism UNKNOWN (do not assume wall jump, extra jump, auto-jump). Holding z can also pass under platforms or fall. Grounded jumps generally rise much higher than initial water jumps. Platforms appear to obstruct ascent from below. Water/falls caused no observed damage; no healing.
Timing uncertainty: Many identical or nearly identical screenshots (including particles) precede substantial movement. Several 0.1–0.2s inputs can appear ineffective, then next short action traverses a platform or completes jump/fall. Even 0.1s Up can precede large continued displacement. Facing can change before travel. Momentum, delayed input, screenshot timing, or temporarily stalled scene are hypotheses, not established. Completed execution only confirms tool execution. Feet touching/above surface alone is weak landing evidence; standing stance, walking on surface, or subsequent high launch stronger. Nominal timing recipes are unreliable.
Geography at pool level RIGHT->LEFT: broad low mossy bank with living green spiny creature -> narrow floating lower stone -> slightly higher leafy platform -> higher broad mossy bridge whose pointed right tip extends far left. Water under all; foreground mushroom often hides character right of lower stone. Bridge left end meets dark wall/overhang. Broad suspended stone platform above bridge; mossy wall ledge above-left; smaller platforms higher. Small mossy platform above-right of broad suspended stone is reachable; farther/higher right ledge holds green bud. Falls from bud attempts return to original pool.
Under-bridge exploration NEW: Can travel left and right at water level behind hanging supports; supports obscure character but did not prevent travel. Far left dark slope/foreground hides character. Repeated Left and Left+z there revealed no visible bank, passage, or upward route; blockage suspected, not proven. Returned right beneath bridge despite many static frames. Jumping under bridge remained below it; clear pointed right end for unobstructed ascent.
Lower route: Confirmed water->stone from either side, with directional+z 0.4s and opposite short correction releasing z sometimes succeeding. Up 0.1s from above stone left half recently carried beyond RIGHT edge into pool; not safe neutral landing. Earlier confirmed stone->leafy: from stone right edge Left+z 0.4 then 0.2, Up 0.1; reproduced this segment (high launch confirmed leafy contact). Earlier Left+z 0.4 twice from leafy reached bridge. Many other attempts fall short, overshoot, or pass underneath. Direct water->leafy often fails; newer evidence supersedes old assumption it cannot help: sustained Left+z at leafy RIGHT side or Right+z at LEFT side repeatedly produced high ascent above it without a directly observed stable landing. Releasing direction/jump during those ascents often led to water. One sustained Left+z sequence from water right of leafy (0.4 repeated, including static frame) rose high above-left; another Left+z 0.4 reached bridge tip; walking Left confirmed stable bridge footing. Thus a bypass of explicit stone landing has worked, but is unreliable. Apparent leafy contact followed by Up 0.1 also caused large leftward displacement/fall.
Bridge tip behavior: This segment, leafy jump reached tip with feet below surface; continued Left+z 0.4 produced high ascent above bridge, right of broad suspended stone; Left 0.4 (z released) landed on broad stone with crouch/particles. Exact launch mechanism uncertain. Later similar continued Left+z at tip instead moved UNDER bridge. Do not infer repeatable edge climbing.
Upper routes previously achieved: Bridge -> broad suspended stone -> wall ledge above-left (Left+z 0.4+0.2, Up 0.4). Attempts wall ledge -> higher right small stone failed back to bridge. Alternative broad stone -> small mossy platform above-right succeeded, then bud ledge attempt fell short into pool.
Recent bridge->broad stone attempts: Starting ~240px left of platform, Right+z 0.4, 0.2 (static), 0.4 fell short/below back to bridge. Up+z 0.4 beside left edge drifted left, feet above top ~150px left; Right+z 0.4 fell short. Up+z 0.2 then 0.1 beside edge returned to bridge (first frame feet still below top). SUCCESS from closer position just left of platform: release z on Left 0.1, Right+z 0.4 reached above left edge; Right 0.1 twice (static), then Right 0.4 confirmed standing at LEFT edge.
Broad stone->small mossy: Jump from broad stone's left portion using Right+z 0.4 twice missed and fell beyond bridge tip; Left 0.1 recovery failed to pool. Later walked across broad stone using Right 0.2 twice (first static), confirmed RIGHT-edge stance. Small target ~240px right and 150px higher. Right+z 0.4 twice (first static) reached above-left of target, feet ~65px above top. Released z with Right 0.2 three times (static/slight movement), then Right 0.4 confirmed standing on small mossy platform. Next Right+z 0.4 toward bud ledge immediately next observed fram
